# Third-party RFP and questionnaire sources

No third-party questionnaire file is redistributed in this repository. The benchmark under `examples/` is original synthetic Xelqara content.

The following public resources were reviewed as references or possible customer-supplied inputs. Their current terms must be checked before copying, modifying, or redistributing any file:

- [VeriRFP free security questionnaire template](https://verirfp.com/security-questionnaire-template)
- [SecureSlate free SIG-lite-style template](https://getsecureslate.com/blog/vendor-security-questionnaire-template)
- [QuestFill vendor questionnaire template](https://questfill.com/VendorSecurityQuestionnaireTemplate)
- [NIST SP 1305](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/1305/final)
- [Cloud Security Alliance CCM](https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/artifacts/cloud-controls-matrix-v4-1)
- [Shared Assessments SIG](https://sharedassessments.org/sig/)
- [Google VSAQ repository](https://github.com/google/vsaq)

Customer-provided RFPs must be used only with written authorization and must remain outside the public repository. Official proprietary questionnaire wording must not be scraped into model-training data without a compatible license.
